global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of individual lighting gear pieces that must be packed into flight cases. Each piece must be assigned to exactly one case.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for one piece of lighting gear (e.g., a label or index). Use this to refer to that specific piece when assigning it to a flight case.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the specified gear piece (in the same units as case_weight_limit). This value contributes to the sum of weights in whichever case the piece is placed and must not cause that case to exceed its limit.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum allowed weight for each identical storage trunk (in the same weight units as the garments). The summed weights of garments placed in any trunk must not exceed this capacity.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of garments (shirts, coats, etc.) that must be folded and assigned. Every one of these garments must be placed in exactly one trunk.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a single garment (for example 'shirt_01' or 'coat_A'). Used to reference each garment when assigning it to a trunk.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the given garment (its folded weight) expressed in the same units as the trunk capacity. This value is added to a trunk's load when the garment is assigned there.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum allowed weight that a single shipping box can carry (same weight units as sack weights). When summing the weights of all feed sacks placed into a box, that total must not exceed this capacity.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of individual feed sacks that must be packed and shipped. Every one of these sacks must be placed in exactly one box.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific sack of feed (e.g., SKU or sequential number). Used to reference which sack is assigned to which box.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of that particular feed sack (in the same units as box capacity). Used to calculate box load totals so no box exceeds its capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum allowed weight that any single identical cargo crate can carry; no group of cartons assigned to the same crate may have a combined weight exceeding this limit.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of packed cartons that must be placed into the crates; each of these cartons must be assigned to exactly one crate.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific packed carton to be loaded into a crate; used to refer to that carton when assigning it to a crate.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the specified carton; this value contributes to the crate's total load and must be counted toward the crate_permitted_load when grouping cartons.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total weight an archival carton can hold (in the same units used for item weights). No carton may contain books whose summed weights exceed this limit; this is the per-carton constraint the packing must respect.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of paperback volumes that need to be packed. Each of these volumes must be placed into exactly one carton; this number sets how many item entries the solver should expect.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a single paperback volume (e.g., accession number or label). Used to refer to that specific book when assigning it to a carton.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the given paperback volume in the same units as the carton_max_weight. The sum of volume_weight values for all books placed in one carton must not exceed carton_max_weight; these values determine feasibility and influence the number of cartons needed.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Total storage capacity of each identical memory card (expressed in the same units as the photo file sizes). This is the maximum combined size of photo files that can be placed on a single card.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of high-resolution photo files to be copied; the count of items that must each be assigned to exactly one memory card.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific photo file (e.g., filename or index). Used to reference that file when assigning it to a memory card.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Storage size of the photo file (in the same units as card_capacity). This is the amount of card space the file consumes and it must be placed wholly on a single card.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The time limit (capacity) of a single blank disc, expressed in a chosen time unit (e.g., seconds). The total durations of tracks placed on any disc must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of audio tracks that must be burned. Every one of these tracks must be placed on exactly one disc (no splitting or duplicating).

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a track (e.g., title, filename, or index) used to refer to that specific audio item when assigning it to a disc.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The playback length of the track in the same time unit as disc_time_capacity_seconds (e.g., seconds). When assigning tracks to discs, sum these durations per disc to check the capacity constraint.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowable weight that a single shipping box can carry. The pharmacist must ensure the total weight of vials placed into any box does not exceed this limit (same units as vial weights).

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of sealed medication vials that need to be packed. Each of these vials must be assigned to exactly one shipping box.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a specific sealed medication vial, used to reference that vial when assigning it to a box.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Weight of the individual vial (in the same units as box_max_load). This value is summed with other vial_weights in a box to verify the box does not exceed its allowable load.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum allowable total weight that a single collection bin can hold in this scrapyard arrangement. When assigning scrap pieces, the combined weights of pieces placed into any one bin must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of individual scrap metal pieces that must be placed into the bins. This is the count of items the foreman needs to assign so each piece goes into exactly one bin.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific scrap metal piece (e.g., a label or index). The foreman uses this id to refer to and assign that particular piece to a bin.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the individual scrap piece (in the same units used for bin capacity). This value is summed with other pieces in a bin and must be used to ensure the bin's total does not exceed bin_max_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum weight (in the same units as crate weights) that a single transport pallet can carry. When assigning crates, the sum of crate weights on any pallet must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of small crates that need to be loaded onto pallets. Each crate must be assigned to exactly one pallet, and this count indicates how many crate entries to process.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for an individual crate (e.g., a label or index). Use this to refer to and assign that specific crate to a pallet.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the specified crate, in the same units as the pallet_capacity. This value is used to ensure the total weight placed on any pallet does not exceed its capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum carrying weight of one gift bag (in the same units as favor weights). No bag's total contents may exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of party favors that must be packed. Each favor must be placed in exactly one bag.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific party favor (e.g., Favor_1). Used to refer to that favor when assigning it to a bag.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of this favor. When packing, the sum of favor_weight values in any single bag must not exceed bag_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum weight a single backpack can carry. When packing, the sum of the weights of all items assigned to any one backpack must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct camping items that must be packed. Each of these items must be placed into exactly one backpack.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or label for a specific camping item (e.g., 'sleeping_bag', 'stove_1', or an index). Used to distinguish items when assigning them to backpacks.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of this particular camping item. This contributes to the total weight of the backpack it is assigned to and must be accounted for when ensuring no backpack exceeds the backpack_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum weight each identical cargo container can hold. All parcel weights use the same units; the total weight of parcels assigned to any container must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of prepared parcels that need to be loaded. Each of these parcels must be placed into exactly one container.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a prepared parcel (e.g., label or index). Used to reference each parcel so it is assigned exactly once to a container.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Weight of the parcel in the same units as container_capacity. These weights are summed per container to ensure no container is loaded beyond its capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum weight a single growing tray can safely carry (in the same units as pot weights). This is the limit used to check that the sum of pot weights placed on any tray does not exceed its safe capacity.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of potted plants that must be placed onto the trays. Every one of these pots must be assigned to exactly one tray.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific potted plant (e.g., label or index) used to refer to that pot when deciding which tray it goes on.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the individual pot (including soil and plant) in the same units as the tray capacity; used to compute the total load placed on a tray.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum capacity of a single identical mailing tube (in the same units used for poster weights). The sum of poster weights placed into any tube must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of posters that need to be rolled and packed. Each poster must be assigned to exactly one tube.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a single poster (e.g., SKU, title, or index). Use this to refer to that poster when deciding which tube it goes into.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight or rolled thickness of this poster (in the same units as tube_capacity). This value adds to the tube's load and the total in any tube must not exceed tube_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The storage capacity of each identical USB drive (in the same units as the asset sizes). No USB may hold more total data than this capacity.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of asset bundles that must be copied. Each bundle must be placed entirely on a single USB.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for an individual asset bundle, used to reference and assign that specific bundle to a USB.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The storage size of the asset bundle (in the same units as usb_capacity). When assigning bundles to a USB, the sum of asset_size values on that USB must not exceed usb_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum safe storage capacity of a single cryobox (the upper limit on the combined weight/volume of vials placed into that box). All vial weights are compared against this value when checking that a cryobox is not overloaded.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of biological sample vials that must be placed into cryoboxes. Every one of these vials must be assigned to exactly one cryobox in the arrangement.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific sample vial (e.g., a label or index). Used to reference which vial is being placed into which cryobox.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The storage weight/volume value of the vial (in the same units as cryobox_capacity). This numeric value contributes to the cryobox's running total and must not cause the box to exceed cryobox_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum weight a single delivery crate can carry (in the same weight units as loaf weights). No crate's total loaf weights may exceed this limit.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of loaves that must be placed into crates; each loaf must go into exactly one crate.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific loaf (e.g., an index or label) used to refer to that loaf when assigning it to a crate.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the loaf in the same units as the crate capacity; used to ensure the sum of weights in any crate does not exceed the crate_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum allowed bulk (the crate allowance) for each identical storage crate. The sum of the book_bulk values of books placed into any single crate must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of donated books to be packed. Each of these books must be placed into exactly one crate.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a donated book (for example a catalog tag, short title, or donation ID). Use this to refer to each specific book when assigning it to a crate.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The bulk (size or effective weight) of the book that counts against a crate's allowance. When packing, sum this value for all books in a crate and ensure the total does not exceed crate_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The capacity of each identical flash drive, measured in bytes. When packing photos, the sum of file sizes placed on any single drive must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of photo files that need to be archived onto the drives. Each photo must be placed on exactly one drive; none may be omitted or duplicated.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a photo file (for example a filename or image ID). Use this to refer to which specific photo is assigned to a drive.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The size of the photo file in bytes. When assigning photos to drives, the sum of file_size_bytes for all photos on a drive must be ≤ drive_capacity_bytes.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed maximum volume each identical glass jar can hold (expressed in milliliters). The sum of volumes of all ingredients placed in any jar must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct ingredients that must be transferred into jars. Each ingredient must be placed entirely in exactly one jar (no duplication or splitting).

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for an ingredient (e.g., its name or code). Used to reference that specific ingredient when assigning it to a jar.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The volume of that ingredient in milliliters. This is the amount of space the ingredient occupies in a jar and is counted against jar_capacity_ml; ingredients are indivisible and must go wholly into a single jar.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total thickness that any single mailing envelope can hold. All garments placed into the same envelope must have their thicknesses summed and not exceed this limit; this is the constraint used to decide valid packings.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of garments that need to be packed into envelopes. Each of these garments must be placed whole into exactly one envelope.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a specific garment (for example an SKU or an index). Use this to refer to that garment when assigning it to an envelope.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The thickness of the garment (in the same units as the envelope_thickness_limit). This value contributes to the envelope's filled thickness and must be counted in full for whichever envelope the garment is placed into.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed duration limit of each audio disc — the maximum total playtime that can be burned onto a single disc. Expressed in a time unit (e.g., minutes or seconds); all song runtimes use the same unit.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of songs in the compilation/setlist that must each appear intact on exactly one disc.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a song (for example a track number or a short title) used to refer to that song when assigning tracks to discs.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The playtime (duration) of the song in the same time unit as disc_max_playtime; this value contributes to a disc's total playtime and cannot be split across discs.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The volume capacity of each identical plastic bin (in the same units as toy volumes). The sum of volumes of all toys placed in any one bin must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of toys that need to be packed into the bins. This should equal the count of toy entries provided and all must be assigned to bins.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a single toy (e.g., "toy1", "doll_A"). Each toy_id refers to one whole toy that must be placed entirely into exactly one bin.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The volume of the toy in the same units as the bin capacity. This is the amount of bin space the toy occupies and is added to the bin's total filled volume when placed.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum thickness allowance of a single binder (in the same thickness units used for documents). All binders are identical; the total thickness of sheets placed into any binder must not exceed this capacity.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of loose documents/sheets that need to be filed into binders. Each document must be placed in exactly one binder.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for an individual loose document or sheet (e.g., a label or index) used to reference that specific sheet when assigning it to a binder.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Thickness of the document (measured in the same units as binder_capacity). When grouping documents into a binder, the sum of their thickness values must not exceed the binder_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The rated maximum weight a single pallet can safely carry (same for every pallet). When grouping boxes, the sum of their weights on any pallet must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total count of boxed products in the back room that must be placed onto pallets; each box must be assigned to exactly one pallet.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for an individual boxed product (e.g., SKU or index) used to refer to that box when assigning it to a pallet.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The weight of the specific box (in the same units as pallet_capacity_kg). This value is added to a pallet's load when the box is placed on that pallet.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The storage quota of each identical cloud folder (in the same units as file sizes). The sum of file sizes placed in any folder must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of project files that must be backed up. Every file must be placed in exactly one folder.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier (e.g., filename) for a project file; used to refer to that file when assigning it to a folder.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The storage size of the file (in the same units as the folder quota) that contributes to a folder's used capacity when the file is placed there.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed space allowance of each identical tray (in whatever unit the pharmacy uses, e.g., unit‑dose slots or volume units). The sum of the space used by lots placed in a tray must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of distinct medication lots that must be placed into trays. Each of these lots must be assigned exactly once to a tray.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a medication lot (for example a lot number or barcode). This identifies a lot that must remain whole and be placed entirely in a single tray.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The amount of tray space that the lot occupies (in the same units as tray_capacity). When grouping lots into a tray, the sum of their lot_space values must not exceed the tray_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total thickness a single portfolio sleeve can hold (use the same units as each print's thickness). This is the bin capacity that must not be exceeded when grouping prints into a sleeve.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of printed photos that need to be packed. Every one of these prints must be placed in exactly one sleeve (no omissions or duplicates).

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a single printed photo (for example a filename, order line, or sequence number). Use this to refer to that specific print when assigning it to a sleeve.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The thickness of that printed photo in the same units as the sleeve_thickness_limit. When prints are grouped into a sleeve, these thickness values are summed and must not exceed the sleeve limit.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum bulk that each identical duffel bag can hold (in the same units as item bulk). The sum of item_bulk assigned to any single bag must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of distinct pieces of camping equipment to pack. Each of these items must be placed entirely in exactly one bag.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier or short name for a particular piece of gear (for example, 'sleeping_bag' or 'cook_set') used to refer to that item when assigning it to a bag.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The bulk (size/weight) of this gear item measured in the same units as bag_capacity. This value is added to a bag's total when the item is assigned and cannot cause the bag to exceed bag_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum allowed combined footprint that a single display tray can hold (in the same units as each piece's footprint). Use this to check that the summed footprints of pieces placed on any tray do not exceed what the tray can carry.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of jewelry pieces that must be placed into the trays. Every piece must be assigned to exactly one tray; this number counts all pieces to be arranged.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier or label for a specific jewelry piece (for example 'ring_1' or 'pendant_A'). Use this to refer to each piece when planning which tray it goes on.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The footprint (space/area or equivalent units) occupied by this jewelry piece on a tray. When evaluating a tray, sum the piece_footprint values of all pieces placed there and ensure the total does not exceed tray_capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The fixed space or weight allowance of each identical reel (in the same units as component sizes). No reel's total of placed components may exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of individual components that must be loaded onto reels. Each listed component must be placed on exactly one reel (cannot be split).

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for the component (e.g., part number or index). Use this id to reference which reel the component is assigned to.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The space or weight that this component consumes on a reel (in the same units as reel_capacity). This amount must be counted toward a reel's total and cannot be divided across reels.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: Maximum usable internal volume of a single insulated case. The combined volumes of all dishes placed into one case cannot exceed this value. Units should match those used for each dish's volume.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: Total number of prepared dishes that must be packed for delivery. Every dish listed must be placed into exactly one case.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: Unique identifier for a prepared dish (for example a name or numeric id) used to reference that dish when assigning it to a case.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: Volume occupied by that dish inside a case. When packing, the sum of dish_volume values for dishes in any single case must not exceed the case_volume_capacity. Use the same units as the case capacity.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum total volume a single identical curbside bin can hold (use the same units as bottle volumes). When packing bottles, the sum of bottle volumes assigned to any bin must not exceed this value.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of glass bottles on the route that must be placed into bins. This equals the number of item entries; every bottle must be assigned to exactly one bin.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a single glass bottle (e.g., an index or label). Use this ID when specifying which bin that bottle is placed into.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The volume of the individual bottle (in the same units as the bin capacity). This value is summed with other bottles assigned to the same bin to check the bin's filled volume; a bottle cannot be split between bins.

global_fields.name: bin_capacity
global_fields.scenario_description: The maximum allowed combined weight or bulk that a single identical storage crate can hold. This is the crate limit that the sum of all paintings placed in one crate must not exceed.

global_fields.name: n_items
global_fields.scenario_description: The total number of framed paintings (pieces) that need to be packed into crates. Each painting must be assigned to exactly one crate.

item_fields.name: item_id
item_fields.scenario_description: A unique identifier for a framed painting (for example an inventory number or title) used to refer to that specific piece when assigning it to a crate.

item_fields.name: weight
item_fields.scenario_description: The numeric weight or bulk measure of the painting used for packing calculations. These values are summed per crate and must not cause the crate to exceed the crate_capacity.
